text: The Earthquake-Related Government Risk Financing Initiatives in Myanmar (2020–2025) encompass a series of policy, budgetary, and regional engagement measures aimed at protecting public finances against seismic shocks. The initiative is built on a legal and institutional framework that includes a Disaster Management Fund, ex-ante budgetary instruments, contingent financing in development projects, and participation in ASEAN regional programs for disaster risk financing and insurance. Despite the political crisis in 2021, Myanmar made modest institutional progress in disaster risk financing.
